description: Shared building blocks of the histogram, box plot, beeswarm, lollipop, dumbbell and diverging bar charts: distribution statistics, glow filters and mark motion.

docs:
Histogram kit: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/histogram

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/kits/histogram-kit/. A helper module that the other items import; you rarely import it yourself.

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
